evidence.reason: After edit returns `valu` (undefined identifier) and calls metering.evaluate(units, 0, "benchmark") instead of the prior (units, 0.1, "monthly"), changing both multiplier and plan semantics.
After edit swaps priorities to [multiplier/2, multiplier], so priorities[0] used in the return expression becomes multiplier/2, halving the effective rate relative to before.
chargeUnit is the shared value referenced by both subscriptionCharge (forward) and usageCharge (backward), so edits on either side propagate through this symbol.
Test only asserts `await subscriptionCharge(40) > 0`, which would not catch the 'valu' typo or the multiplier/plan change, leaving behavior jointly relied on unverified.

result.userExplanation: 两处改动共同改变了计费乘数与计划参数，且左侧返回值疑似拼写错误，现有测试仅检查正数无法覆盖这些行为变化。
result.suggestedAction: 请修改 src/subscription.ts 中 subscriptionCharge 的返回值（将 `valu` 改为 `value`），并确认 metering.evaluate 的 multiplier 与 plan 参数是否应保持 0.1/"monthly"；同时复核 src/metering.ts 中 usageCharge 的 priorities 顺序是否应恢复为 [multiplier, multiplier/2]。
